Author: Anil Verma

1  IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH
AT INDORE
BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE ANIL VERMA  ON THE 19 th OF JUNE, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 25332 of 2023

BETWEEN:-
 RAMSWAROOP S/O DOLATRAM REBARI,
 AGED ABOUT 25 YEARS,
OCCUPATION: DRIVER

R/O: TIGARIYA THANI, NEAR RAINGARH, DISTRICT  BANRA, (RAJASTHAN)
 
 (BY SHRI NILESH DAVE - ADVOCATE)

AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH  STATION HOUSE OFFICER THROUGH POLICE STATION  BHANPURA, DISTT. MANDSAUR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 ....
(BY SHRI AJAY RAJ GUPTA - PANEL LAWYER)

This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER 1.

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.343/22 registered at Police Station Bhanpura, District Mandsaur for the offence under Section 363, 366, 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
2. As per the prosecution story, on 9.9.2022 father of the prosecutrix lodged a missing person report as well as the FIR by stating that his minor daughter/prosecutrix is missing from home.
During the investigation it has been gathered that present applicant abducted the prosecutrix, took her with him to different places and committed rape upon her.
Accordingly offence has been registered.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant contended that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this matter.
He is in custody since 13.9.2022.
Investigation is over and charge sheet has been filed.

Prosecutrix was a consenting party and she was remained in the company of the Ramswaroop vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150431039/
1 applicant for a period of 4 days.

sentences.text: She has been examined before the trial Court and turned hostile.
Her father (PW-1) and mother (PW-2) have also turned hostile.
Final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.
Hence, he prays that applicant be released on bail.
4. Per-contra, learned PL for respondent/State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.

5. Perused the case diary as well as the impugned order of the court below.
6.

Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for the parties, nature and gravity of allegation as also taking note of the fact that prosecutrix (PW-3) has been examined before the trial Court, she categorically stated in her statement that she was major at the time of incident and present applicant neither abducted her nor committed any rape upon her,
prosecutrix's father (PW-1) and mother (PW-2) have also deposed in the same manner and have turned hostile, therefore, in view of the evidence available on record, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
7.
Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/- with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

He shall abide by the conditions enumerated u/S. 437(3) Cr.P.C.
C.C. as per rules.

(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE trilok Ramswaroop vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150431039/
